question: ______ became a part of India in 1962.
solution:
The correct option is 4, i.e __**Goa**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **India** liberated Goa from** the Portuguese** in 1961, but officially became a part of India in **1962**__.
 
• Goa was conferred statehood on **30 May 1987**. 
 
• Under the 12th Amendment of the Indian Constitution, Goa, Daman and Diu were included in Indian Union as a Union Territory on acquisition from Portugal.
